sloka: तथा ज्येष्ठा हि मे माता कौसल्या दीर्घ दर्शिनी ।त्वयि धर्मम् समास्थाय भगिन्याम् इव वर्तते ॥२-७३-१०॥
transliteration: tathā jyeṣṭhā hi me mātā kausalyā dīrgha darśinī ।tvayi dharmam samāsthāya bhaginyām iva vartate ॥2-73-10॥

translations.english: In the same way my eldest mother the farsighted Kausalya, too adhered to righteousness and conducted herself towards you like a sister.
